title: Optimize Your Portfolio Returns with DigiToads (TOADS), Stellar (XLM) and Zcash (ZEC)
description:
Disclaimer: The text below is a press release that is not part of Cryptonews.com editorial content.

The crypto landscape is peppered with all types of crypto projects, some of which have better prospects than others. 

However, due to the recent slow action in the crypto market, it could be difficult to navigate all the opportunities and choose the right tokens to optimize your portfolio returns. 

Below, we’ll introduce you to DigiToads (TOADS), Stellar (XLM), and Zcash (ZEC), three diversified projects that could generate exponential growth in 2023. 

DigiToads’ Growth Prospects Raise Millions.

DigiToads is a new head-turning meme coin that has taken the market by storm. In a short period, it managed to raise $4.4 million, and more than 293 million TOADS tokens are already sold out, despite still being in its presale stages.

The reason for this exploding growth is the mechanisms behind the TOADS tokens. This fuels a complex ecosystem that brings multiple profit opportunities to TOADS holders. 

Despite its meme coin status, DigiToads is more about financial freedom and passive income than the toad meme itself, which makes it a disruptive project in this viral market. 

The DigiToads ecosystem is designed as a play-to-earn environment, known as the Swamp, a virtual world where you will get a DigiToad character that you can raise, nurture, and train to win fighting competitions. 

The best players receive TOADS tokens that can be used to improve their characters or generate passive income. 

Long-term investors are attracted by the deflationary nature of the TOADS tokens, which means that the supply is designed to decrease in the long term, protecting the value of the tokens. 

Also, the platform offers an NFT staking pool that rewards users who buy and stake NFTs on the platform, generating passive returns. 

Due to these features, DigiToads is one-of-a-kind in this crowded market. It is also attracting sustainable investors, thanks to its mission to fund the reforestation efforts in the Amazon by donating to charities.

BUY DIGITOADS NOW

Stellar Taps into Billion-Dollar Market.

Stellar is one of the main DeFi companies in the financial industry. Recently, it announced its newly unlocked ability to implement SWIFT, which is the international network that makes international payments possible – the SWIFT network is currently used by banks all over the world. 

SWIFT integration paves the way for Stellar to become a new disruptor this year, promising high returns to its adopters. Thanks to this strategic partnership, XLM could become a main driver of innovation in the financial industry, challenging the leading position of traditional banks. 

Zcash Blends Privacy with Control.

In the first days of cryptocurrency, people assumed that their transactions are private. However, in reality, crypto transactions are public.

As a result, several alt coins emerged, one of them being Zcash, which focuses on privacy and anonymity. 

While there are other privacy coins on the market, Zcash stands out from the crowd because of the degree of control it offers. 

In other words, transactions are private only if users choose to hide the details. This is thanks to its innovative technology known as zero-knowledge proofs, which can process transactions without necessarily requiring information about them.
